name: constraint-scope
body: The write-surface enforcement of the constraint-scope law: `rust.apg.layers.validate.eval_constraint`, invoked by the write path `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change`, validates that a new constraint carries its scope through its layer. The scan path `rust.apg.layers.tree.ingest_tree` loads a constraint carrying an `attaches-to`, and `apg spec lint` reports it.
